{{Quote|Well, it looks like you have finally put the pieces together.|Lom Pyke to the Jedi|<ref name="The Lost One">{{TCW|The Lost One}}</ref>}}
A '''mission''' to the planet [[Oba Diah/Legends|Oba Diah]] occurred during the [[20 BBY/Legends|final month]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] were sent to speak with the [[Pyke Syndicate/Legends|Pykes]] after new evidence revealed that deceased Jedi [[Sifo-Dyas/Legends|Sifo-Dyas]] and an [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]] named [[Silman/Legends|Silman]] had gone to Oba Diah to negotiate with the Pykes. Upon arrival, Kenobi and Skywalker found evidence that the two had been there, getting [[Lom Pyke/Legends|Lom Pyke]] to bring them to Silman in exchange for amnesty concerning the Pykes' betrayal of the Jedi.

[[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] arrived on the planet not long after, looking to cover up loose ends to the conspiracy surrounding Sifo-Dias. Dooku [[Death/Legends|killed]] Silman and confronted the two Jedi. The three dueled onto a landing platform where they were met by Lom and his forces to provide the Jedi with assistance. Dooku managed to slay Lom and jump onto a cargo freighter, where he called for his ship to pick him up. Anakin Skywalker went after him, but Dooku managed to defeat Skywalker and escape via his ship.
